head: #[#set std.raw(lang: none, theme: none);#show std.raw: it => { set std.text(font: ("DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Serif CJK SC"), size: 10.5pt, weight: 400, style: "normal", tracking: 0pt, dir: ltr, lang: "en", hyphenate: false, fill: std.rgb("#334155")); let body = it.lines.map(line => line.body).join(std.linebreak()); if it.block { set std.par(justify: false, leading: 0.55em); std.block(width: 100%, breakable: true, fill: std.rgb("#f5f6f8"), stroke: 0.5pt + std.rgb("#dde2e9"), radius: 3pt, inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt), above: 0.4em, below: 0.4em, body) } else { std.highlight(fill: std.rgb("#f0f2f5"), radius: 2pt, extent: 1.5pt, body) } };
